h1: Most businesses know how much traffic they’re getting. But very few know how much {{revenue each visitor}} brings in.
ex: Example business. Your own numbers come next.
body: The **Revenue Per Visitor™ Calculator** will show you exactly which acquisition channels are bringing in the most revenue, and which are bleeding money.
pr: So you can see where the opportunity lies to add $1.5M in annual revenue from the visitors you’re already attracting, without increasing your marketing spend.
up_next: Next question: Where does most of your traffic or audience come from today?
